scope: actual server startup recovery, draft continuation identity, notification receipts, archived chats and saved send results
method: isolated local PostgreSQL; actual recover/worker/messaging paths; synthetic computer stream and connector results; no external transport

findings.issue: Server restart converted draft.response into runtime.reconcile and lost treatment metadata.
findings.before: Permanent regression failed: expected draft.response, received runtime.reconcile.
findings.fix: Retain draft event identity and frozen notification receipt across bounded host recovery; allow the interrupted follow-up to resume even when all statuses were published.

findings.issue: Restart reconciliation queued new draft work in an already archived chat.
findings.before: Permanent regression failed: expected zero pending wakes, received one.
findings.fix: Complete old draft work and release its lease without enqueueing a continuation for an archived channel.

scenarios: Restart before and after publication; actual resumed worker receives event requestSource and draftStatusAcknowledged, includes stored status, completes a useful follow-up.
Control and treatment survive three consecutive restarts, reject late interrupted replies, stop after the bounded third retry, and emit one exhaustion notice.
An unrelated later outcome keeps its own unconsumed receipt until its own continuation.
Archived chats receive no new recovery wake in either arm.
Running and completed drafting turns; saved confirmed and unresolved send invocations; refresh/send/discard races preserve one terminal outcome without connector replay after the existing timeout.
validationNotes: One concurrent validation attempt timed out in an oversized restart-bound fixture; its still-running global recovery interfered with the next fixture. Reduced that fixture from 24 to two mixed outcomes, retained the separate original 24-send test, then all five sequential repeat cycles and the final combined suite passed without timeout changes.
Server, worker and messaging typechecks; server build; architecture checks pass.
limits: No new live-model, native Grokbot, desktop UI or iOS runtime trial in this pass.
No real email/Slack/APNs, production state/config change or deployment.
Treatment remains opt-in with default zero percent.
Default-mode deliberately injected new-run/new-call replay and silent-model acknowledgement gaps remain; this does not semantically classify arbitrary model prose.
